source: Owner direct chat during the sprint-jump request
owner_message_original: Да и себе пометь на будущее, что полные прогоны всех анимация совершать не надо, проверяем только то, что затрагивает непосредственно.
owner_message_english_translation: Also note for the future that full runs of all animations are unnecessary; we check only what is directly affected.
decision: Standing rule: verify only directly affected behavior and related transitions for animation/gameplay changes. Do not repeat full animation or feature sweeps.
scope: Current sprint-jump task and future work. Supersedes older broad regression instructions unless a later explicit owner instruction requests such coverage. Appropriate compile/load checks remain within scope.
